data.name: io.github.beepboop2025/palimpsest
data.description: Live censorship, China economic, and tamper-evident AI evaluation tools with bounded analysis.
data.title: Palimpsest — censorship, China economy and model-eval observatory

entries.description: The proven Palimpsest 1.9.1 release boundary exposes six anonymous, read-only tools. Native fail-closed China publication-rights behavior belongs to a separate deployment candidate and is not claimed live by this card; clients must independently honor the metadata-only Pages restriction until that release is proven.
representativeQueries: Read the current China publication-rights status without inferring an economic value or direction.
Which China economic routes are metadata-only restricted on the static site?
What does Palimpsest currently observe about Stock Connect, and what cannot that channel establish?
Is the China economy evidence broad enough for a composite conclusion, or is the observatory abstaining?
Which Chinese information-control measurements are current, stale or missing?

metadata.deploymentNote: This card describes the exact deployed and independently re-probed MCP 1.9.1 boundary.
metadata.liveVersionAuthority: Initialize the linked MCP remote and compare serverInfo.version before treating a release as deployed.

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 contract for static public readings, including metadata-only China publication-rights status, the global Belt and Road coverage contract, newsroom evidence and evaluation records.
capabilities: inspect BRI lifecycle, economics, local-impact and source gaps
representativeQueries: Give me the current metadata-only China publication-rights status.
Which China economic endpoints are unavailable under the reviewed source policy?
Inspect the BRI source and project-field contract for Gwadar, CPEC, CMEC and Kyaukpyu.
Check whether Palimpsest has promoted any China economic forecast target.

metadata.versionAuthority: Read info.version from the linked OpenAPI document; it is independent of the deployed MCP release.

entries.description: Metadata-only restricted endpoint for the former aggregate China economic observation ledger. The reviewed policy denies CFETS and ChinaMoney value publication, so it exposes no observations or derivatives and must not be interpreted as zero, calm or directional evidence.
representativeQueries: Why are China economic observations unavailable for publication?
Which reviewed source decisions deny value redistribution?
What policy and status digests bind the current restricted endpoint?

metadata.rights: The reviewed default-deny source policy does not authorize publication of the CFETS or ChinaMoney value family or affected derivatives.
metadata.coverageBoundary: The status publishes policy-derived metadata and zero observation rows; unavailable or restricted evidence is not a measurement.

entries.description: Metadata-only restricted endpoint for the current China Observatory index because its mixed dependency graph contains rights-denied economic derivatives. It exposes no score, state or direction.
representativeQueries: Why is the current China Observatory index unavailable?
Which policy clock governs the metadata-only restriction?
Which endpoints are included in the quarantine closure?

metadata.freshnessAuthority: Read rights_evaluated_at and the policy review intervals from the publication-rights status; this catalog does not freeze them.

entries.displayName: Palimpsest Belt and Road Observatory Coverage Contract
entries.description: Repository-ready global BRI source, rights, lifecycle, economic and local-impact coverage contract with priority Pakistan, Gwadar, Balochistan, Myanmar and Kyaukpyu dossiers. Version 2 links a separately licensed World Bank WDI national-context bundle; neither surface is complete ingestion or a deployed project-count API.
capabilities: map economic and local-impact evidence gaps
separate Balochistan political, civic, armed, legal and rights lanes
inspect the bounded NarcoScope country overlay contract
discover national economic context without inferring BRI causation
representativeQueries: Which sources can verify a Gwadar project from announcement through operation?
What evidence is available for CMEC financing, land and local livelihoods?
How does Palimpsest keep peaceful Baloch civic advocacy separate from armed organizations and legal designations?
Which BRI economic fields are build-ready and which still need rights review?

metadata.coverageBoundary: Source discovery and adapter readiness are not ingestion, and unlike project lifecycle or claim states are never summed. WDI national series cannot establish BRI causation or project, actor or corridor facts.

entries.displayName: Palimpsest BRI World Bank WDI Economic Context
entries.description: Repository-ready World Bank World Development Indicators observations for China, Myanmar and Pakistan. The 3,564 country-year-indicator rows retain observed, forecast and unavailable status; they provide national economic context only and do not establish BRI causation or any project, actor or corridor fact.
capabilities: separate observed, forecast and unavailable rows
retain source release and acquisition clocks
verify source attribution and redistribution rights
representativeQueries: Which World Bank WDI indicators are available for China, Myanmar and Pakistan from 1960 through 2025?
How many WDI rows are observed, forecast or unavailable in the current bundle?
Use national context without claiming that a change was caused by a BRI project or corridor.

entries.displayName: Financial Evidence Agent Skill and Fleet Router
entries.description: Canonical Agent Skill that routes questions across Palimpsest China evidence, Seiche system funding and money/capital transmission, LiquiLens institution risk, and Undertow market-exit liquidity without collapsing their evidence boundaries.
capabilities: select canonical MCP and REST surfaces
representativeQueries: Which product should an agent call for China evidence, system funding, institution risk or exit liquidity?
Route a capital-market question without treating one product as universal coverage.
